answer: Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. The price of trying is 160 separate visits, each one billed £83 at the door, paid up front for every single name, while the crystal stays small. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Every entry must show Sealed leather worker town seal before the ledger opens, because a seal workers carry after hide audits. The orchard is on the docket. The trellis is checked, not assumed.
